detail.longDescription: Hello all 👋 I run a home server that has outlived three routers, two hard drives and most of my patience. It now has opinions. Here for # SelfHosted war stories, # Debian , firewall graphs that look like modern art, and the occasional website nobody asked for. I also write terminal tools with far too many colors. Follow along if you like uptime, bad puns and reading logs at 2 a.m. # Introduction
